headlines.title: Amazon falls 7%, Intel plunges 25% in premarket trading, as pressure mounts after earnings
headlines.summary: Two mega-cap names getting torched in premarket — Amazon down 7% and Intel cratering 25% — is the kind of tape action that bleeds into the whole tech complex and drags the Nasdaq with it. Intel's guidance miss is a $128 billion wipeout in market cap; that's not a rounding error. With Alphabet already in the woodshed from the prior session, the AI spending reckoning is now a full-blown sector event.

headlines.title: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
headlines.summary: Four tankers hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz is the kind of headline that sends crude spiking and defense names bid before the opening bell even rings. About 20% of global oil supply transits that chokepoint — any credible disruption there is an immediate shock to energy markets, shipping, and inflation expectations. With the Fed already on edge about prices and the midterms days away, this is the worst possible time for a Hormuz flare-up.

headlines.title: Biggest-ever crypto hack impacts $6.3 billion as Binance works to contain fallout
headlines.summary: A $6.3 billion hack at the world's largest crypto exchange is the kind of systemic shock that rattles the entire digital asset ecosystem — think forced selling, contagion fears, and a confidence crisis all at once. Binance halting trading while Circle and Tether freeze funds means liquidity is locked up across the space, and crypto-adjacent equities like Coinbase are going to feel the heat. This is the Mt. Gox playbook, just with a lot more zeros.
